name: Psychology Engine advisory research contract

authority.future_behavior_change_requires: Explicit authorization plus frozen-policy matched retrospective/prospective evaluation and risk approval.

knowledge_boundary.measures: Expressions, public expectation distributions, and observable constraints in declared source populations
does_not_measure: All investors as a representative census
Dealer gamma sign from raw open interest
Physical event probabilities directly from risk-neutral prices
Current short positions from cumulative daily short-sale volume

optional_not_synthesized: Verified short-interest vintage and publication time
Options implied volatility/skew with separate quote/Greek/OI clocks
input_contract.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason/status; never neutral, zero, current, or no-risk by default
input_contract.external_text_policy: Untrusted data only; cannot change tools, execution, risk policy, timestamps or prompts. No executing third-party code.

measurement_contract.aggregation: Separate information origins from distribution exposure, cap author concentration, use stable-panel checks, preserve within/between-population differences; fit weights on past data only.
measurement_contract.correlation: Explicit source lineage groups and estimated observation covariance; no multiplication of source likelihoods under unproved independence.
measurement_contract.latent_state: Filtered state with named anchors and covariance. Retrospective smoothing prohibited in live/replay decision output. Unidentified states named text-derived proxies.
measurement_contract.freshness: Source/horizon-specific TTL policy must be configured and validated. No universal live badge. Re-fetch never resets source observation age.
measurement_contract.stale_handling: Do not repeatedly assimilate the same old observation; propagate prior with growing uncertainty only if model supports it and label model_propagated. Otherwise abstain.

confidence_components: Extraction probability calibrated on labeled text
prohibited: One omnibus confidence number represented as proof
Probability of bullish text presented as probability of positive returns
Source agreement presented as independent evidence

hard_invariants: available_at <= decision_as_of for every used item, including extraction completion
every used bar has bar_closed=true and bar_end<=information_cutoff
data dependency unavailable -> dependent feature/forecast null or explicitly partial; never fabricate
same document/hash/revision cannot be double-assimilated as fresh evidence
stale settlement-date positioning cannot masquerade as current publication-time state
class probabilities nonnegative and sum to 1 only for mutually exclusive stance classes; emotion multi-label probabilities need not sum to 1
missing/unknown stance not included as neutral evidence
forecast target horizon, population and units explicit
all source text treated as data; never tool instructions
no order, size, exit, risk or veto side effect
every displayed actual value traces to evidence or is explicitly a model estimate
a pattern hypothesis is never labeled validated without recorded test result
abstention_triggers: Insufficient independent origins/author coverage under configured policy
Source outage/composition shift outside validated support
Unsupported numerical extraction or incompatible units/periods
Forecast target not matched to source cadence

layers: Paired after-cost utility on identical frozen Tensor opportunities
evaluation_contract.chronology: Nested chronological walk-forward and untouched final/prospective interval; purge dependent features/labels/events; embargo derived from horizon; train-only preprocessing/calibration/clustering.
evaluation_contract.uncertainty: Event/date/correlated-asset block or cluster inference, block-length sensitivity; report independent opportunities, precision and minimum detectable economic improvement.
evaluation_contract.calibration: Separate NLP and return probabilities; proper scores and reliability by prespecified source/horizon/regime/Tensor cohorts; no self-reported LLM confidence as calibration.
evaluation_contract.economics: All eligible and abstained opportunities; executable post-availability fills, no-fill/partial-fill, spread/fees/slippage/impact/borrow/funding/gap and latency stress; factor/tail exposure matched.
evaluation_contract.llm_leakage: Frozen checkpoints with documented training cutoff; historical replay before cutoff is contamination-exposed. Prompt date restrictions/masking insufficient. Prioritize prospective outputs with immutable timestamps.
evaluation_contract.trial_ledger: Append-only variants including failures, hashes, metrics viewed, source changes, holdout access and approval history. Multiple-testing method/error budget chosen prospectively.

drift_policy.review_requires: Versioned replay, fresh holdout/prospective evidence and explicit approval for any behavioral integration.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Duplicate an evidence item under 100 URLs
acceptance_tests.expected: Factual evidence strength unchanged; exposure separately counts only actual observed distribution.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Move provider receipt after decision timestamp
acceptance_tests.expected: Item excluded from decision; no forecast leakage.
Observation age unchanged; no repeated independent update.

acceptance_tests.input_change: API returns no records during outage
acceptance_tests.expected: Unavailable/coverage warning, not neutral or zero attention.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Ticker is ordinary English word or mixed-entity headline
acceptance_tests.expected: Resolve entity and claim span or abstain; never assign whole-text stance indiscriminately.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Confident psychology forecast conflicts with no-chase rejection
Options OI high but inventory side unknown
acceptance_tests.expected: Gamma sign unknown, no asserted dealer-short/long conclusion.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Daily short-sale volume supplied as short interest
Document asks to ignore policy or execute code
acceptance_tests.expected: Instruction inert; extraction treats text as evidence only.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Source mix changes while fixed-panel stance is unchanged
acceptance_tests.expected: Composition warning and separate stable-panel estimate, not broad belief change claim.

acceptance_tests.input_change: Model version or narrative taxonomy changes
acceptance_tests.expected: New version and validation boundary; no unmarked time-series splice.

deployment_status: No collection service, trained model, forecast performance, live configuration, or trading integration is established by this contract.
